mix_frequency_estimate: CALL ~75-85%, FOLD ~15-25%, RAISE ~0-5% (raise is essentially pure-FOLD-EV: folds out CO's air, isolates dominated; pot geometry — 3bb to call into 12.5 with 97.5bb behind — makes raise-for-protection an EV-loser since CO's continue range is value-heavy).
reasoning:
Action verdict CALL is correct, but the equity-realization argument is stronger than the raw-equity argument the architect leans on, and CO's c-bet range composition deserves a sharper read than the '~50% value / ~50% bluff' framing.

Range-and-position geometry: CO is the cold-caller, not the opener. UTG (the opener) checks the flop on K72r — a board with the highest preflop-opener range-advantage in poker — which significantly caps UTG's representation and inverts the usual c-bet bluff incentive. When CO then bets into BTN (still to act) AND BB (still behind, OOP, unacted), CO is stabbing into two live ranges with a cold-caller starting distribution that does not contain AA/KK/QQ (those 3-bet). CO's value combos on K72r are KQs/KJs/ATs-if-KTs/77/22 (KK impossible) — a thin value slice. The right read is that CO's bet-into-4-checked range is MORE polar and TIGHTER than architect's framing, not less polar. In 5-way at 25% pot, betting into two unacted players demands range-density; CO's stab is closer to ~65% value (Kx-good-kicker + sets) / ~35% air (offsuit gutters, 86s-type, the occasional 98s float).

K9 equity vs this tightened polar range: dominated by KQ/KJ/KT-suited and crushed by 77/22; ahead of bluffs. Raw equity ~28-32%, not 30-35%. Lower than architect's estimate, but the action verdict survives because equity-realization carries the EV.

Realized-equity / R-factor: BTN closes flop action IP with one OOP player (BB) behind for turn/river. R-factor on K9-top-pair-IP-no-draw is ~0.90-0.95 — hero can check back turns for pot control, fold to multi-street pressure, and never face a tough OOP river spot. BDFD reality check: board is rainbow (Ks-spade, 7d-diamond, 2c-club), zero hearts; K9hh has NO backdoor flush draw, NO gutshot, NO meaningful runner-runner. Pure made-hand equity-realization play.

Pot odds 19.4% required vs ~28-32% raw equity gives ~9-13pp equity surplus before R-factor; with R~0.92 IP-closing-action, realized-equity surplus is comfortable. CALL is +EV by direct odds alone, and IP-realization stacks on top. FOLD frequency 15-25% reflects the BB-behind tax and dominated-Kx tax, not a coin-flip on the action label.

RAISE is not viable: 3bb-to-call leaves 97.5bb behind; a raise-to-10bb folds out CO's air (the part of CO's range we beat) and isolates us vs Kx-better + sets. Pure protection-mix is dominated by the IP-realization-flat line.

Verdict: CALL, HIGH confidence on action label.
